lead: The page skeleton: Header, Content and Footer stacked vertically, and nestable. For an app shell with a sidebar use [Sidebar](/sidebar); to lay things out in a row use [Flex](/flex), for columns use [Grid](/grid) (Row / Col). Layout only covers how one page (or one area) is put together. The root Layout sets no height: it fills only when the outside gives it a definite height.

nested.title: Nested
nested.description: A Layout can hold another Layout, e.g. an area with its own header and content.

container.title: Container
container.description: Limits the content's maximum width and centers it horizontally: wrap it around a page's content.

api.title: API Reference
api.parts: Header / content area / footer; a Layout can be nested in another.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles define the header height, the footer padding and Container's maximum-width scale in `layout.css`.
styling.parts: The header, content area and footer
